verdict.rationale: Docs confirm NPM packages for all modules, ES6 module support, and tree-shakable modular design, directly matching the story's bundling/tree-shaking/import workflow, and community comments corroborate TypeScript/React integration in real toolchains. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of tree-shaking effectiveness/bundle size in a real bundler, and no first-party benchmark or case study demonstrating actual dead-code elimination.
